articles.title: Rivers in the Sky Are Soaking the Pacific Northwest
articles.summary: Rivers of water vapor in the sky are bringing days of heavy rain to Oregon and Washington, and high tides raise the risk of flooding.

articles.title: Microsoft's Big Outage Stops Millions From Using Email
articles.summary: A big Microsoft outage stopped millions from using Outlook, Teams and Copilot. Microsoft says it was not a cyber-attack, and fixes are under way.

articles.title: Every Little Bit of Warming Matters
articles.summary: Every tiny bit of warming matters — for corals, heat waves, and storms — and countries meeting in Turkey are talking about how to slow it down, including switching to electricity from solar and wind.
